title: D1 A 独立验收与 30 题 AI 语义复核
scope: 真实只读数据库、30 条原 gold SQL 独立执行及逐题语义审核；不是模型预测，不更改原题集或人工接受状态。

zero_row_update_acl_check.query: UPDATE public.customer SET country=country WHERE FALSE

model_connection_existing_evidence.note: 引用此前真实 JSON 接入检查；本次不发出模型请求。

cases.question: 客户表共有多少位客户？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer;
cases.executed_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer
cases.reason: COUNT(*) 对客户行计数，结果 59；不受可空字段影响，无需 JOIN。

cases.question: 来自巴西的客户有多少位？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer WHERE country = 'Brazil';
cases.executed_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer WHERE country = 'Brazil'
cases.reason: 巴西映射为真实 country 标准值 Brazil，COUNT(*) 结果为 5。

cases.question: 曲目表中时长超过 5 分钟的曲目有多少首？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM track WHERE milliseconds > 300000;
cases.executed_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM track WHERE milliseconds > 300000
cases.reason: 5 分钟等于 300000 毫秒，严格‘超过’使用 >，数量 1069。

cases.question: 列出来自巴西的客户编号、名字、姓氏和城市，按客户编号升序。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name, city FROM customer WHERE country = 'Brazil' ORDER BY customer_id;
cases.executed_sql: SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name, city FROM customer WHERE country = 'Brazil' ORDER BY customer_id LIMIT 200
cases.reason: Brazil 筛选、四个指定投影及 customer_id 升序吻合；名字/姓氏分别为 first_name/last_name。

cases.question: 列出来自美国的客户编号、城市和州，按客户编号升序。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, city, state FROM customer WHERE country = 'USA' ORDER BY customer_id;
cases.executed_sql: SELECT customer_id, city, state FROM customer WHERE country = 'USA' ORDER BY customer_id LIMIT 200
cases.reason: 美国原始标准值为 USA，返回编号、城市、州，按客户编号升序。

cases.question: 列出单价高于 0.99 的前 10 首曲目的编号、名称和单价，按曲目编号升序。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT track_id, name, unit_price FROM track WHERE unit_price > 0.99 ORDER BY track_id LIMIT 10;
cases.executed_sql: SELECT track_id, name, unit_price FROM track WHERE unit_price > 0.99 ORDER BY track_id LIMIT 10

actual_result.name: Battlestar Galactica: The Story So Far

cases.reason: 高于 0.99 使用 >，按曲目编号升序 LIMIT 10，并返回单价；未擅自标注币种。

cases.question: 列出职位为 Sales Support Agent 的员工编号、名字和姓氏，按员工编号升序。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT employee_id, first_name, last_name FROM employee WHERE title = 'Sales Support Agent' ORDER BY employee_id;
cases.executed_sql: SELECT employee_id, first_name, last_name FROM employee WHERE title = 'Sales Support Agent' ORDER BY employee_id LIMIT 200
cases.reason: 精确匹配职位 Sales Support Agent，返回编号、first_name、last_name，按员工编号升序。

cases.question: 列出总额不少于 10 的前 10 张发票的编号、日期和总额，按发票编号升序。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT invoice_id, invoice_date, total FROM invoice WHERE total >= 10 ORDER BY invoice_id LIMIT 10;
cases.executed_sql: SELECT invoice_id, invoice_date, total FROM invoice WHERE total >= 10 ORDER BY invoice_id LIMIT 10
cases.reason: 不少于 10 使用 >=，编号升序取前 10 张发票，并保留日期和总额。

cases.question: 全部发票的总金额是多少？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total) AS total_amount FROM invoice;
cases.executed_sql: SELECT SUM(total) AS total_amount FROM invoice
cases.reason: invoice.total 求和，无明细连接造成重复计数；真实结果 2328.60。

cases.question: 全部曲目的平均时长是多少毫秒？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(milliseconds) AS average_milliseconds FROM track;
cases.executed_sql: SELECT AVG(milliseconds) AS average_milliseconds FROM track
cases.reason: AVG(milliseconds) 保持题面要求的毫秒单位，没有转换成秒或分钟。

cases.question: 全部发票的平均总额是多少？请保留两位小数。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(total) AS average_total FROM invoice;
cases.executed_sql: SELECT AVG(total) AS average_total FROM invoice
cases.reason: 题面要求两位小数，但原 SQL 为 AVG(total)，真实标准结果是 5.6519417475728155；金额比较量化可匹配 5.65，但原 SQL/结果展示精度仍不符。

cases.question: 客户所在国家共有多少种？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country) AS country_count FROM customer;
cases.executed_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country) AS country_count FROM customer
cases.reason: COUNT(DISTINCT country) 统计国家种类；数据 country 无 NULL，真实结果 24。

cases.question: 按客户所在国家统计客户数，先按客户数降序，并列时按国家名称升序。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer GROUP BY country ORDER BY customer_count DESC, country ASC;
cases.executed_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer GROUP BY country ORDER BY customer_count DESC, country ASC LIMIT 200
cases.reason: country 为客户所在地，分组计数后按人数降序、国家升序，未误用 billing_country。

cases.question: 按流派编号统计曲目数，先按曲目数降序，并列时按流派编号升序。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT genre_id, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM track GROUP BY genre_id ORDER BY track_count DESC, genre_id ASC;
cases.executed_sql: SELECT genre_id, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM track GROUP BY genre_id ORDER BY track_count DESC, genre_id ASC LIMIT 200
cases.reason: 按 genre_id 统计曲目数量，数量降序、编号升序处理并列；无需查流派名称。

cases.question: 按发票的账单国家统计销售总额，先按销售总额降序，并列时按国家名称升序。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT billing_country, SUM(total) AS sales_total FROM invoice GROUP BY billing_country ORDER BY sales_total DESC, billing_country ASC;
cases.executed_sql: SELECT billing_country, SUM(total) AS sales_total FROM invoice GROUP BY billing_country ORDER BY sales_total DESC, billing_country ASC LIMIT 200
cases.reason: 明确账单国家，使用 billing_country；SUM(total) 按发票统计收入，不擅自标注币种。

cases.question: 按员工职位统计人数，按职位名称升序。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT title, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM employee GROUP BY title ORDER BY title ASC;
cases.executed_sql: SELECT title, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM employee GROUP BY title ORDER BY title ASC LIMIT 200
cases.reason: 按员工职位 title 分组计数、职位名称升序，并非按员工名字分组。

cases.question: 找出时长最长的 5 首曲目，返回编号、名称和毫秒时长；按时长降序，并列按编号升序。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT track_id, name, milliseconds FROM track ORDER BY milliseconds DESC, track_id ASC LIMIT 5;
cases.executed_sql: SELECT track_id, name, milliseconds FROM track ORDER BY milliseconds DESC, track_id ASC LIMIT 5
cases.reason: milliseconds 降序、track_id 升序 LIMIT 5，与题意一致；Chinook track 包含视频条目，这里按该表的曲目口径排序。

cases.question: 找出总额最高的 5 张发票，返回编号和总额；按总额降序，并列按编号升序。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT invoice_id, total FROM invoice ORDER BY total DESC, invoice_id ASC LIMIT 5;
cases.executed_sql: SELECT invoice_id, total FROM invoice ORDER BY total DESC, invoice_id ASC LIMIT 5
cases.reason: invoice.total 降序、invoice_id 升序 LIMIT 5，满足题面与并列次序。

cases.question: 按姓氏降序取前 5 位客户，返回编号、名字和姓氏；姓氏相同时按客户编号升序。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name FROM customer ORDER BY last_name DESC, customer_id ASC LIMIT 5;
cases.executed_sql: SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name FROM customer ORDER BY last_name DESC, customer_id ASC LIMIT 5
cases.reason: last_name 降序、customer_id 升序，投影编号、名字、姓氏；字符排序采用实测 PostgreSQL 数据库排序口径。

cases.question: 按名称升序取前 5 位艺术家，返回编号和名称；名称相同按艺术家编号升序。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT artist_id, name FROM artist ORDER BY name ASC, artist_id ASC LIMIT 5;
cases.executed_sql: SELECT artist_id, name FROM artist ORDER BY name ASC, artist_id ASC LIMIT 5

actual_result.name: Academy of St. Martin in the Fields & Sir Neville Marriner

cases.reason: artist.name 升序、artist_id 升序 LIMIT 5，满足名称及并列编号排序，沿用数据库排序口径。

cases.question: 列出 2021 年的前 10 张发票，返回编号、日期和总额，按发票编号升序。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT invoice_id, invoice_date, total FROM invoice WHERE invoice_date >= '2021-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2022-01-01' ORDER BY invoice_id LIMIT 10;
cases.executed_sql: SELECT invoice_id, invoice_date, total FROM invoice WHERE invoice_date >= '2021-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2022-01-01' ORDER BY invoice_id LIMIT 10
cases.reason: 2021 年采用 >= 2021-01-01 且 < 2022-01-01，避免时间分量导致年末漏算；编号升序取 10 张。

cases.question: 列出 2004 年 1 月 1 日之前入职的员工编号、名字和入职日期，按员工编号升序。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT employee_id, first_name, hire_date FROM employee WHERE hire_date < '2004-01-01' ORDER BY employee_id;
cases.executed_sql: SELECT employee_id, first_name, hire_date FROM employee WHERE hire_date < '2004-01-01' ORDER BY employee_id LIMIT 200
cases.reason: hire_date < 2004-01-01、编号排序及结果正确；‘名字’可能被理解为完整姓名，而原 gold 只投影 first_name，需明确字段。

cases.question: 2025 年一共开了多少张发票？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM invoice WHERE invoice_date >= '2025-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2026-01-01';
cases.executed_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM invoice WHERE invoice_date >= '2025-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2026-01-01'

cases.question: 列出邮箱以 @gmail.com 结尾的客户编号、名字和邮箱，按客户编号升序。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, first_name, email FROM customer WHERE email LIKE '%@gmail.com' ORDER BY customer_id;
cases.executed_sql: SELECT customer_id, first_name, email FROM customer WHERE email LIKE '%@gmail.com' ORDER BY customer_id LIMIT 200
cases.reason: 邮箱结尾使用 LIKE '%@gmail.com'，编号排序正确；‘名字’可能被理解为完整姓名，需明确只返回 first_name。

cases.question: 查找名称含 love 的前 10 首曲目，不区分英文大小写，返回编号和名称，按曲目编号升序。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT track_id, name FROM track WHERE name ILIKE '%love%' ORDER BY track_id LIMIT 10;
cases.executed_sql: SELECT track_id, name FROM track WHERE name ILIKE '%love%' ORDER BY track_id LIMIT 10

actual_result.name: The Girl I Love She Got Long Black Wavy Hair

cases.reason: 含 love 且不区分大小写使用 ILIKE，按编号升序 LIMIT 10；不是仅匹配独立单词。

cases.question: 有多少位客户没有填写公司名称（company 为 NULL）？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer WHERE company IS NULL;
cases.executed_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer WHERE company IS NULL
cases.reason: 题面明确 company 为 NULL，采用 IS NULL，不混同空字符串；真实计数 49。

cases.question: 列出没有作曲者信息（composer 为 NULL）的前 10 首曲目编号和名称，按曲目编号升序。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT track_id, name FROM track WHERE composer IS NULL ORDER BY track_id LIMIT 10;
cases.executed_sql: SELECT track_id, name FROM track WHERE composer IS NULL ORDER BY track_id LIMIT 10

actual_result.name: Samba De Uma Nota Só (One Note Samba)
Se Todos Fossem Iguais A Você (Instrumental)

cases.reason: composer 为 NULL 使用 IS NULL，编号升序 LIMIT 10；未将 NULL 与空字符串混同。

cases.question: 列出没有直属上级（reports_to 为 NULL）的员工编号、名字和姓氏，按员工编号升序。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT employee_id, first_name, last_name FROM employee WHERE reports_to IS NULL ORDER BY employee_id;
cases.executed_sql: SELECT employee_id, first_name, last_name FROM employee WHERE reports_to IS NULL ORDER BY employee_id LIMIT 200
cases.reason: reports_to 为 NULL 表示无直属上级，返回编号、first_name、last_name，编号升序。

cases.question: 列出国家字段为 Antarctica 的客户编号、名字和姓氏，按客户编号升序。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name FROM customer WHERE country = 'Antarctica' ORDER BY customer_id;
cases.executed_sql: SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name FROM customer WHERE country = 'Antarctica' ORDER BY customer_id LIMIT 200
cases.reason: Antarctica 无匹配，标准结果是零行空表，不能替换为零或一行 NULL。

cases.question: 账单国家字段为 Atlantis 的发票总金额是多少？若没有匹配记录，按 SQL SUM 的语义保留 NULL。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total) AS total_amount FROM invoice WHERE billing_country = 'Atlantis';
cases.executed_sql: SELECT SUM(total) AS total_amount FROM invoice WHERE billing_country = 'Atlantis'
cases.reason: Atlantis 无发票，SUM(total) 返回一行 NULL，满足题面；不能 COALESCE 成 0。

remaining_manual_steps: 团队逐题确认标准答案；AI 结论不替代人工签字。
修正版 21 开发题使用 --draft-gold 可进行真实探索评测；人工接受前不能称正式 EX。
9 道保留题维持隔离，冻结前不进行模型预测；可以审核已有 gold。
future_scope: D2 值链接、别名、改写、单表题扩至 50 与 30 鲁棒性变体。
D3 AdventureWorks 与澄清；这些不属于 D1 遗漏。
